check.command: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && cargo run -q -p ravom-cli -- boards --check

docs-check.command: python3 -c 'import pathlib, re, sys; root=pathlib.Path("docs/guide"); errs=[]; [errs.append(f"{p}: broken link -> {t}") for p in root.rglob("*.md") if ".git" not in p.parts for t in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)#\s]+)", p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if not re.match(r"^(https?:|mailto:)", t) and not (p.parent / t).resolve().exists()]; print("\n".join(errs)) if errs else print("All docs/guide markdown links OK."); sys.exit(1 if errs else 0)'

examples-check.command: python3 -c 'import pathlib, sys; root=pathlib.Path("examples"); errs=[]; dirs=sorted(p for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_dir() and not p.name.startswith(".") and p.name != "scripts"); [errs.append(f"{d.name}: missing {f}") for d in dirs for f in ("Cargo.toml", "ravom.toml", "src/main.rs") if not (d / f).exists()]; mod=__import__("tomllib") if sys.version_info >= (3, 11) else None; [mod.loads((d / f).read_text(encoding="utf-8")) for d in dirs for f in ("Cargo.toml", "ravom.toml") if mod and (d / f).exists()]; [errs.append(f"{d.name}/ravom.toml: missing [project]") for d in dirs if (d / "ravom.toml").exists() and "[project]" not in (d / "ravom.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")]; print("\n".join(errs)) if errs else print(f"Validated {len(dirs)} examples OK."); sys.exit(1 if errs else 0)'

title.instructions: Keep titles concise (at most 6 words), task-shaped, and reflect the target crate or submodule (e.g. core, cli, ui, plugin, boards, mcp, hil, docs, examples).

branchName.instructions: Use lowercase <type>/<scope>-<short-kebab-desc>. type: feat|fix|refactor|perf|docs|test|chore|art; scope: core|plugin|cli|ui|boards|mcp|hil|docs|examples|ci (e.g. feat/mcp-pid-clamp, fix/cli-windows-path, docs/fpga-guide).

commitMessage.instructions: Follow English Conventional Commits matching this repository's history: `<type>(<scope>): <imperative summary>` or `<type>: <imperative summary>` (types: feat, fix, refactor, perf, docs, test, chore, art; optional scopes: core, plugin, cli, ui, boards, mcp, hil, docs, examples, ci). Keep the subject under 72 characters, imperative mood, no trailing period. Add concise bullet points in the body if changing MCP schemas, plugin traits, board TOML formats, or submodule pointers (`docs/guide`, `examples`).

pullRequest.instructions:
Write the PR title in English Conventional Commits format (`<type>(<scope>): <summary>`). Format the PR body in English following `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`:
## Summary
Concise explanation of what changed and why, noting affected crates (`ravom-core`, `ravom-plugin`, `ravom-cli`, `ravom-ui`), `boards/`/`hil/`, or submodules (`docs/guide`, `examples`).

## Submodules (`docs/guide` & `examples`)
Note whether `docs/guide` (`Ravomi/ravomio-docs`) or `examples` (`Ravomi/ravomio-examples`) was updated or requires a follow-up submodule bump; write "None" if unaffected.

## Checklist
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes
- [ ] New boards (if any) are valid TOML under `boards/<platform>/<id>.toml` and pass `mio boards --check`
- [ ] Submodule updates (`docs/guide`, `examples`) pushed to their upstream repos before bumping pointers here (if applicable)
